metadata.description: Personal Agent Skills library — spec-conformant, versioned per-plugin, distributed as a Claude Code plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: pickup-handoff
plugins.description: Session-bracket companions for Claude Code. /pickup hydrates context at the start of a session (reads HANDOFF.md, surfaces open PRs and recent CE artifacts, optionally probes VPS health for openclaw-prod projects). /handoff serializes session state at the end (writes a structured HANDOFF.md with what was built, decisions made, what's next, and gotchas).
